text: Yes, the cafeteria should definitely introduce the plant-based menu. Firstly, the dietitian-reviewed rotation ensures that all nutritional requirements are met without compromising taste or variety. Secondly, the inclusion of a live fermentation station not only enhances food preparation but also aligns with current trends towards sustainable practices and healthier eating habits on campuses. Moreover, seasonal produce contracted from local suppliers offers cost-effective alternatives while ensuring high-quality ingredients throughout the year. Lastly, the success of similar changes at North Campus demonstrates significant demand retention following menu modifications, further supporting the potential for growth in this direction. Investing in these initiatives will not only benefit the environment but also contribute to student health and satisfaction.
